Link enviPath objects

Source: R/link.R
epLink.Rd

epLink returns mappings between enviPath object types.

Usage

epLink(from, to, init = NULL, pkg = NULL, BPPARAM = bpparam(), rate = 5)

Arguments

from

Character scalar. String specifying the object type from which mapping is performed.

to

Character scalar. String specifying the object type to which mapping is performed.

init

Character vector. Vector of strings specifying the initial values of from that should be mapped to to. When null, all objects belonging to from in pkg are used. (Default: NULL)

pkg

Character scalar. String specifying the unique identifier of the package from which objects should be mapped When null, EAWAG-BBD is used. (Default: NULL)

BPPARAM

A BiocParallelParam object specifying how the requests should be parallelised. (Default: bpparam())

rate

Numeric scalar. Integer number specifying the amount of requests per second to be sent to the enviPath API when BPPARAM is not serial. (Default: 5)

Value

A data frame with links between from and to.

Details

For transparency, the performed raw API calls can be accessed with attr(x, "call"), where x is the output of epLink.

Examples

if( is_active ){
# Perform login with your credentials
epLogin(username, password)

# Define custom reaction identifier
rxn_id <- "2b6bbcc5-77f4-4bed-92a9-731cdc978f6a"

# Link custom reaction to related compounds
epLink("reaction", "compound", rxn_id)
}
#> Hi nature lover, welcome to enviPath!
#>                               reaction                             compound
#> 1 2b6bbcc5-77f4-4bed-92a9-731cdc978f6a 7281d994-9f4a-4f7f-9e50-90b131c11da3
#> 2 2b6bbcc5-77f4-4bed-92a9-731cdc978f6a befe8eeb-e8f8-4b4a-90b1-d0584a75f8cb
